requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Requirement contains concern-mixing (functional action + quality criterion) per Pohl §25.2. Decomposed into a functional requirement (inform security service) and a quality requirement (response time ≤ 2 seconds).

source_fragments: If the glass break detector of a window detects the pane has been damaged, the system shall inform the security service.

fields.condition: the glass break detector of a window detects the pane has been damaged

structured_requirements.final_statement: If the glass break detector of a window detects the pane has been damaged, the system shall inform the security service.
structuring_notes: Extracted functional action from concern-mixed requirement. Timing constraint moved to separate quality requirement.

fields.condition: after detecting the pane has been damaged

structured_requirements.final_statement: The system shall inform the security service within 2 seconds at the latest after detecting the pane has been damaged.
structuring_notes: Extracted quality criterion (response time) as a separate artefact per Pohl §25.2.
